visual_review.notes: Full original face viewed: Chaos Spell, 2 Energy, no Power; Repeat 2 Energy; move one enemy unit to a location with a unit sharing its controller. No Action or Reaction.

findings: The enemy unit is the target; destination occupancy is a location restriction, not a second target. Destination is fixed at finalization.

Interpretation from 449.2.c and 451.1: a destination that loses all units sharing the target controller is invalid at resolution; if the target would move there, it instead Recalls. No card-specific Temptation FAQ was located.
A Move prevented by a movement restriction does not Recall. A target already at the destination is not becoming present there again.
The earlier research note about attached Unit anchors was wrong: Core 718.6 and the Radiance notes prohibit a unit remaining attached. Current unit objects and tokens count; plain gear does not.
Repeat keeps independent finalized targets and destinations; original execution can change destination legality for the Repeat.
rules_review.hub_recheck_result: Rules Hub still links the October 9, 2026 Core Rules. Radiance patch notes confirm unit detachment and prohibition on attachment under 718.6.
